goal: understand the main components involved in registration, their responsibilities, how they interact, and identify main integration points
scope: user registration component and its interactions
source_goal: I am an integration tester. I need to design integration tests for the user registration functionality. Before defining the tests, I need to understand the main components involved in registration, their responsibilities, and how they interact when a new user creates an account. I also need to identify the main integration points that should be exercised during the tests.
